name: Greeting
text: Hello! Great to meet you here today. I am really glad we could join this session.

name: Agreement
text: Yes, I completely agree with that point. That makes a lot of sense to me.

name: Question
text: Can you explain more about what you just said? I would love to hear more details.

name: Positive Feedback
text: That is a really interesting perspective, thank you very much for sharing that with us.

name: Disagreement
text: I am not quite sure I fully agree with that. Could we discuss it a little bit further?

name: Summary
text: So to summarize what we have discussed so far, the main points seem to be very clear now.

name: Redirect
text: That is interesting, but let us try to move on to the next topic now, shall we?

name: Clarify
text: What exactly do you mean by that? Could you please elaborate just a little bit more for me?

name: Encouragement
text: You are doing a great job, please keep going. I am listening carefully to everything you say.

name: Closing
text: I think we have covered everything today. Thank you all very much for a great discussion.
